name: Memento Mori
publisher: Cinemax (Czech Republic) / Dtp entertainment (Germany) / Lace Mamba Global (UK) / Got Game Entertainment (US) / Akella (Russia) / Bohemia Interactive (re-release)

locations.note: The investigation begins with missing paintings at the Hermitage Museum, where several acts take place, including one beneath the museum.
The trail leads to a residence in Scotland, with a castle, a cellar and a meeting room.
The story ends at a Finnish cloister, where André is found.

routes.name: Max and Lara
routes.note: From the Hermitage to a Scottish castle and a Finnish cloister.
